Description (expected vs actual): Expected: dragging up over tasks scrolls the day list. Actual: vertical scroll is dead over task rows in the Timeline layout (the DEFAULT inbox view); only drags on blank space scroll. The per-row SwipeActionRow DragGesture swallows the inner ScrollView pan.
Repro steps: Set inbox_layout to Timeline (default). Add ~10 tasks due today. Open Inbox. Drag up starting on a task row.

Description (expected vs actual): Expected (per product principle): no streaks / no bait to reopen. Actual: Profile shows '🔥 X-day streak' and 'Best streak', plus empty-state 'Complete a task to start a streak!'; Guide Tour promotes 'Track your streaks'. Creates don't-break-the-chain pressure.
Repro steps: Open Profile. Observe streak card and stats grid. Read onboarding Guide Tour.

Description (expected vs actual): Expected: perpetual motion respects Reduce Motion. Actual: breathing orbs, sonar rings, and the Pomodoro ring breath run .repeatForever regardless of accessibilityReduceMotion (never referenced anywhere).
Repro steps: Enable Settings > Accessibility > Reduce Motion. Open Brain Dump and Pomodoro. Motion continues.

Description (expected vs actual): Expected: text scales with Dynamic Type. Actual: ~370 hard-coded .font(.system(size:)) and zero ScaledMetric/dynamicTypeSize; nothing scales at large accessibility text sizes and fixed frames will clip.
Repro steps: Set Dynamic Type to an accessibility XXL size. Open any screen.

Description (expected vs actual): Expected: icon-only buttons are labeled for VoiceOver. Actual: only ~8 accessibilityLabel in the app; Pomodoro close/reset/skip/loop steppers, Brain Dump close, calendar nav arrows, checkboxes read as unlabeled 'Button'.
Repro steps: Enable VoiceOver. Swipe through Pomodoro and Brain Dump controls.

Description (expected vs actual): Expected: dictated speech becomes multiple tasks. Actual: when Apple Intelligence is unavailable, extraction splits input on NEWLINES only, so a dictated run-on paragraph becomes one giant task.
Repro steps: On a device without Apple Intelligence, dictate 'call dentist buy milk email sam' as one utterance. Hit Distill.

Description (expected vs actual): Expected: 'weekend' means the same day everywhere and is sensible on Sundays. Actual: typed/swipe nextWeekend() on a Sunday jumps to the Saturday 13 days out, while the reschedule menu's 'This Weekend' (nextWeekdayDate(6)) gives 6 days out — inconsistent and surprising.
Repro steps: On a Sunday: type 'plan trip weekend' (or swipe-left to schedule) vs hold a task and pick 'This Weekend'. Compare resulting dates.

Description (expected vs actual): Expected: permissions requested in-context with rationale. Actual: Location is a dedicated onboarding stage asked before any value is shown; no rationale; Skip only exists on non-location stages, and 'Continue without location' only appears after a denial.
Repro steps: Run first-launch onboarding to the Location step with status notDetermined.

Description (expected vs actual): Expected: one clear hold gesture. Actual: two stacked long-press handlers fire in sequence — reschedule at 0.3s then multiselect at 0.5s — so the reschedule popover briefly flashes before multiselect engages on a long hold.
Repro steps: Press and hold a timeline task past 0.5s. Watch the reschedule popover appear then get replaced by multiselect.

Description (expected vs actual): Expected: a path to re-enable the mic. Actual: after denying microphone/speech permission, the UI shows static text 'Enable microphone in Settings.' with no deep link to Settings.
Repro steps: Deny mic permission, reopen Brain Dump, tap Dictate.

Description (expected vs actual): Expected: onboarding copy matches product values. Actual: Guide Tour tells users to 'Track your streaks and completion rate', reinforcing the mechanic the product says it avoids.
Repro steps: Open the Guide Tour / help.

Description (expected vs actual): Expected: calm, non-agitating idle state. Actual: idle screens keep animating (orb breathing, ring breathing) and the Pomodoro/Brain Dump numeric text rolls every second; for motion-sensitive users this is agitating even before Reduce Motion.
Repro steps: Open Pomodoro and let it sit; open Brain Dump and let it sit.

Description (expected vs actual): Expected: rich-text note editor is accessible. Actual: Notes use a custom UIKit UITextView subclass (NoteBodyEditor); custom editors commonly drop Dynamic Type trait scaling and VoiceOver rotor support — needs explicit verification.
Repro steps: Enable VoiceOver + large Dynamic Type. Open a note and edit rich text.

Description (expected vs actual): Expected: status not conveyed by color alone. Actual: priority (danger/warning/success) and date-category chips rely largely on color; needs text/shape redundancy and contrast check for color-blind users.
Repro steps: View tasks with high/medium/low priority and various due dates in light and dark mode.

Description (expected vs actual): Expected: on-device AI extraction can be evaluated. Actual: cannot be runtime-verified here (no Simulator mic; SystemLanguageModel availability is device-specific). Behavior inferred from code only.
Repro steps: N/A — environment limitation.

Description (expected vs actual): Expected: priorities used sparingly unless the user leans on them. Actual: addressed this session (default normal + adapts to the user's own priority-usage rate); needs regression check that most extracted tasks now come back 'normal'.
Repro steps: Dictate/type several neutral tasks with no urgency words. Distill. Confirm few/no priority badges.

Description (expected vs actual): Expected: calendar dot cache is cheap. Actual: rebuildDotCache queries EventKit across ±30 months on calendar changes; cached afterward but could cost on first paint for users with dense calendars.
Repro steps: Grant calendar access with many events; open Calendar tab.

Description (expected vs actual): Expected: rapid taps are safe. Actual: TaskCheckbox commits completion after a ~0.45s delay for the burst animation; a fast double-tap can toggle complete then immediately uncheck. Likely harmless but worth a runtime check for rage-tappers.
Repro steps: Rapidly double-tap a task's checkbox.

Description (expected vs actual): Positive/keep: empty states exist (empty inbox messages; 'No tasks due this day') and the Brain Dump closure beat celebrates then auto-dismisses — healthy disengagement. Do not regress these in a rewards redesign.
Repro steps: Open app with zero tasks; complete a Brain Dump.

Description (expected vs actual): Expected: consistent categorization model. Actual: Notes have folders but tasks are categorized only by free-text comma tags (EditTaskSheet); perfectionist re-categorizers get an inconsistent mental model across the two.
Repro steps: Edit a task's tags vs organize notes into folders.
